scroll_effects.name: pinned blur curtain (inert until a flyout opens)

motion.evidence: 11 frames captured. Only 2 scroll effects, both `position: fixed` pins (nav + curtain) — NO parallax, NO in-view content reveals, NO scroll-progress transforms. 3 IntersectionObservers / 3 targets, 5 scroll + 2 mousemove listeners, 176 rAF calls (media gallery + progressive-image swap). 30 @keyframes / 24 animation rules, ALL belonging to two subsystems: globalnav-flyout-slide-*, globalnav-search-fade-and-slide, globalnav-scrim-height-change, globalnav-chevron-slide-in-hover; and dotnav-shift-*, dotnav-timed-dot-expand, dotnav-timed-animation, progress-indicator-animating. 0 prefers-reduced-motion rules → NOT respected. 12 captured hover deltas are all the same alpha ramp on chrome text (rgba(0,0,0,0.8)→0.96); zero transform hovers. 6 'entrance' opacity 0→1 events at 150ms are the footer link list resolving, not a designed reveal. 13 disclosure + 10 tab nodes; 0 canvas, 0 video, 0 marquee. Gallery timing from the site's own custom props: --media-gallery-slide-duration 800ms, --media-gallery-bottom-copy-duration 600ms.

notes: Normalized from a 1440px capture. Type: two optical cuts of one superfamily — SF Pro Text below ~20px, SF Pro Display above. Tracking SIGN FLIPS across the cut boundary (17px -0.374px ≈ -0.022em; 21px +0.231px ≈ +0.011em; 28px +0.196px; 56px -0.28px ≈ -0.005em), so the usual 'bigger = tighter' ramp does NOT apply — values are recorded as measured. Sizes are px in source (17/21/24/28/40/44/56); converted to rem at 16px root. No fluid type (`clamp()`) anywhere; the ramp steps at breakpoints 734 / 1068 / 1441 (nav uses 833/834). Weight 700 appears 6 times out of ~1830 nodes — treated as absent. Space: the raw profile shows NO clean 8px grid; control padding is 7-9px block × 11px inline and section padding lands on 40/53/56px, so `base: 8px` is a normalization convenience — the real rhythm is typographic (17px body). Section HEIGHTS are tokenized, not content-derived (--hero-content-height 692px, --promo-content-height 580px). Radius 980px is the site's literal 'fully round' value (35 occurrences), kept rather than collapsed to 9999px because it documents the intent. Only one real box-shadow exists on the whole page. Semantic colors are recorded as fill/glyph PAIRS (surface value vs pre-darkened text value) — that split is the site's most transferable token idea. color.dark is OMITTED: craft.theme.supportsDark is false and meta.color_scheme is 'normal'; the --r-globalnav-background-opened-dark token belongs to the embeddable nav bundle, not to this page. Container 1024px (980px for footer/legal); 12-column flex grid, not CSS grid (29 grid vs 205 flex containers).
